livingCosts.notes: Taylor's own 2026 cost guide (published for Indian applicants but the RM figures are general), range midpoints. Housing: on-campus twin-sharing room (Ruemz/U Residence) RM1,200-RM1,800 + utilities RM150-RM300 per month; off-campus single room RM700-RM1,200 or studio RM1,800-RM2,500+ are the alternatives. Food: total food and groceries RM600-RM900. Transport: RM100-RM250 (LRT/MRT/BRT and occasional Grab). Personal: leisure RM250-RM500. Taylor's overall estimate is RM1,800-RM4,000 per month excluding tuition. Monthly figures with no term basis, so 12 months.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Computer Science (Honours)
programmes.notes: International student fee schedule for the September 2026 intake: total tuition RM124,080 over 9 semesters (3 years) divided by 3. All fees are payable in RM; the USD column is indicative. Compulsory = International Student Annual Fee RM2,500 per year. One-off = enrolment fee RM2,800 + international student charge RM3,000 + EMGS visa application and e-VAL RM2,920 + hospitalisation and surgical insurance RM644; the RM3,000 refundable security deposit is excluded. Excludes the 6% service tax charged to non-Malaysians since 1 July 2025. Taylor's states fees are subject to annual increases. 2024 = February 2024 intake schedule: total tuition RM115,068 / 3.
